_read_me: Pine Labs responses are computed by sim/pinelabs_world.py from everything that has happened (documented rules: no debit without an approved mandate, one debit per one-time mandate, nothing above the cap, no payout above the pool). The entries here only carry each endpoint's documentation status and its documented error, shown to the operator.
verified=true: endpoint and method as read from Pine Labs' docs (by the team, or from the docs excerpt for Payouts). verified=false: guessed; check before recording.
World lookups (fares, stays) and Delhivery still use the 'response' templates: replace example values with what a real site shows at recording time; keep a screenshot.

delhivery.geocode.path: Delhivery Maps → Geocoding  [verify exact path on Delhivery's developer portal]

delhivery.distance.path: Delhivery Maps → Distance Matrix  [verify exact path on Delhivery's developer portal]
delhivery.distance.doc: Delhivery developer portal → Maps → Distance Matrix [verify]
